candidates.change_summary: Remove the require statement that checks _tos.length > 0, allowing execution with empty arrays which changes the revert/success behavior.
Change the inner call to not revert on failure by replacing the if-revert block with an empty block, so failed sub-calls are silently ignored and transfer returns true instead of reverting.
Replace 'return true' with 'return false', making the function return a different boolean value on success.
Remove the entire for-loop body, so no external calls are made, but the function still returns true — changing whether external effects happen.
